sourceMiniAdventureTr: Anahtar ilk denemede kapıyı açmaz; doğru anahtarı bulurlar.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Dào le, jiù shì zhè shàn mén.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān bǎ xiǎo bāo fàng xià lái ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhōng yú dào jiā le!

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 还没开门呢，别跑那么快。
dialogues.pinyin: Hái méi kāi mén ne, bié pǎo nà me kuài.
dialogues.tr: Kapıyı daha açmadık, öyle hızlı koşma.
dialogues.actionTr: Kardeşini kapının önünde durması için uyarır.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Yào shi zài wǒ kǒu dai lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ ná chū lái, wǒ fú zhe bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba, wǒ néng kāi ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Děng bà ba xiān zhǎo duì yào shi ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, xiān shì shì zhè bǎ.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 慢一点，别用太大的力气。
dialogues.pinyin: Màn yì diǎn, bié yòng tài dà de lì qì.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zěn me hái bù kāi ya?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shì bú shì ná cuò le?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Èn, hǎo xiàng bú shì zhè ge.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Bié jí, zài kàn kàn lìng yī bǎ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà bǎ cháng yì diǎn, wǒ kàn jiàn le!

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 对，就在你右边的口袋里。
dialogues.pinyin: Duì, jiù zài nǐ yòu biān de kǒu dai lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 这里还有一把，差点忘了。
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hái yǒu yī bǎ, chà diǎn wàng le.
dialogues.tr: Burada bir tane daha var, az kalsın unutuyordum.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bǎ kàn qǐ lái zhēn xiàng.
dialogues.tr: Bu iki anahtar gerçekten birbirine benziyor.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐ wéi mén huài le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 门没坏，是钥匙还没找对。
dialogues.pinyin: Mén méi huài, shì yào shi hái méi zhǎo duì.
dialogues.tr: Kapı bozuk değil, doğru anahtarı henüz bulamadık.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nà jiù shì shi cháng de zhè bǎ.
dialogues.tr: O zaman şu uzun olanı deneyelim.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ xiǎo bāo gěi wǒ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yě néng bāng máng ná dōng xi!
dialogues.tr: Ben de eşya taşımaya yardım edebilirim!

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè ge qīng, nǐ ná zhè ge ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 乐乐，站在左边，别挡着门。
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, zhàn zài zuǒ biān, bié dǎng zhe mén.
dialogues.tr: Lele, solda dur, kapının önünü kapatma.
dialogues.actionTr: Oğluna kapının solunda yer açmasını söyler.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng, nǐ yě wǎng hòu yì diǎn.
dialogues.tr: Yutong, sen de biraz geri çekil.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè yàng kě yǐ le ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 可以，我也给爸爸让路了。
dialogues.pinyin: Kě yǐ, wǒ yě gěi bà ba ràng lù le.
dialogues.tr: Olur, ben de babama yer açtım.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Yí, zhè bǎ néng zhuǎn le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 对，就是那个，不是刚才那个。
dialogues.pinyin: Duì, jiù shì nà ge, bú shì gāng cái nà ge.
dialogues.tr: Evet, işte o; az önceki değil.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 开了没有？我听见声音了。
dialogues.pinyin: Kāi le méi yǒu? wǒ tīng jiàn shēng yīn le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, bà ba bǎ mén dǎ kāi le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Kāi le! huān yíng huí jiā.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhè me shuō, wǒ zhēn gāo xìng.
dialogues.tr: Bunu senden duymak beni çok mutlu etti.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 可是，我们第一次来这里呀。
dialogues.pinyin: Kě shì, wǒ men dì yī cì lái zhè lǐ ya.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 从今天起，这里就是我们的家。
dialogues.pinyin: Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, zhè lǐ jiù shì wǒ men de jiā.
dialogues.actionTr: Kardeşine buranın artık evleri olduğunu açıklar.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 说得对，家人在一起就好。
dialogues.pinyin: Shuō dé duì, jiā rén zài yì qǐ jiù hǎo.
dialogues.tr: Doğru söyledin, ailemiz bir arada olsun yeter.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān kàn kàn lǐ miàn, zài jìn qù ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 我站在这里就能看见窗户！
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn zài zhè lǐ jiù néng kàn jiàn chuāng hù!

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yě kàn jiàn le, lǐ miàn hěn liàng.
dialogues.tr: Ben de gördüm, içerisi çok aydınlık.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān bié pǎo, dì shàng yǒu dōng xi.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 门边这个箱子要挪一下。
dialogues.pinyin: Mén biān zhè ge xiāng zi yào nuó yī xià.
dialogues.tr: Kapının yanındaki şu kutuyu biraz çekmek gerek.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ men de xiāng zi ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shì, dōng xi yǐ jīng sòng dào le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ xiān bǎ tā fàng dào páng biān.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 慢慢来，里面还有东西呢。
dialogues.pinyin: Màn màn lái, lǐ miàn hái yǒu dōng xi ne.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ fú yī xià zhè biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 我拿小包，大的让爸爸搬。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ ná xiǎo bāo, dà de ràng bà ba bān.
dialogues.tr: Ben küçük çantayı alayım, büyükleri babam taşısın.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiè xiè, xiàn zài mén kǒu kōng le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, gēn zhe jiě jie jìn qù.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Jiě jie, nǐ děng yí xià wǒ!

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ jiù zài nǐ qián miàn, bù zǒu yuǎn.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 先到门里面，别往房间里跑。
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān dào mén lǐ miàn, bié wǎng fáng jiān lǐ pǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men hái yào bǎ bāo ná jìn lái.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ bǎ zhè ge fàng nǎ lǐ?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 先放门旁边，别放在路中间。
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān fàng mén páng biān, bié fàng zài lù zhōng jiān.
dialogues.tr: Şimdilik kapının yanına koy, geçiş yoluna koyma.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Duì, zhè yàng dà jiā dōu néng zǒu.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Fàng hǎo yǐ hòu, xǐ xǐ shǒu ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 妈妈，洗手的地方在哪儿？
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, xǐ shǒu de dì fāng zài nǎr?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 先一起看看，不要乱开门。
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān yì qǐ kàn kàn, bú yào luàn kāi mén.
dialogues.tr: Önce birlikte bakalım, kapıları rastgele açmayalım.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Jìn mén yòu biān shì yí gè fáng jiān.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zuǒ biān yě yǒu yī shàn mén.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Nǎ yí gè shì wǒ de fáng jiān?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Děng dōng xi fàng hǎo le zài kàn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Jīn tiān xiān bǎ mén kǒu shōu hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 是啊，不能一来就到处跑。
dialogues.pinyin: Shì a, bù néng yī lái jiù dào chù pǎo.
dialogues.tr: Evet, gelir gelmez her yere koşamayız.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo ba, wǒ jiù zài zhè lǐ děng.
dialogues.actionTr: Beklemeyi kabul ederek kapının içinde durur.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ bāng wǒ shǔ shù xiǎo bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 钥匙也得放好，不能再找不到。
dialogues.pinyin: Yào shi yě děi fàng hǎo, bù néng zài zhǎo bú dào.
dialogues.tr: Anahtarı da yerine koymalı, yine kaybolmasın.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ tā gěi wǒ ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 妈妈，你知道哪把是对的吗？
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, nǐ zhī dào nǎ bǎ shì duì de ma?
dialogues.tr: Anne, hangisinin doğru olduğunu biliyor musun?
dialogues.actionTr: Annesinin doğru anahtarı tanıyıp tanımadığını sorar.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 就是长的这把，我记住了。
dialogues.pinyin: Jiù shì cháng de zhè bǎ, wǒ jì zhù le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 短的先放到另一个口袋。
dialogues.pinyin: Duǎn de xiān fàng dào lìng yí gè kǒu dai.
dialogues.tr: Kısa olanı şimdilik başka cebe koyayım.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè yàng jiù bú huì ná cuò le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Xià cì wǒ lái bāng nǐ zhǎo!
dialogues.tr: Bir dahakine bulmana ben yardım ederim!
dialogues.actionTr: Bir sonraki sefer yardım etmeyi hevesle teklif eder.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 你先别把自己的小包忘了。
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié bǎ zì jǐ de xiǎo bāo wàng le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 雨桐提醒得对，小包还在门边。
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng tí xǐng de duì, xiǎo bāo hái zài mén biān.
dialogues.tr: Yutong doğru hatırlattı, küçük çanta hâlâ kapının yanında.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, ná guò lái gěi wǒ kàn kàn.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 给你，里面还有我的小火车。
dialogues.pinyin: Gěi nǐ, lǐ miàn hái yǒu wǒ de xiǎo huǒ chē.
dialogues.tr: Al, içinde oyuncak trenim de var.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 你在车站找回它后就一直拿着呢。
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ zài chē zhàn zhǎo huí tā hòu jiù yì zhí ná zhe ne.
dialogues.tr: İstasyonda onu bulduğundan beri elinden bırakmıyorsun.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 现在小火车也到新家了。
dialogues.pinyin: Xiàn zài xiǎo huǒ chē yě dào xīn jiā le.
dialogues.tr: Şimdi oyuncak tren de yeni eve geldi.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ kě bié ràng tā dǎng zài mén kǒu.
dialogues.tr: Onu kapının önüne koyup yolu kapatma.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Bú huì, wǒ xiān fàng jìn bāo lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Hěn hǎo, děng shōu shí hǎo le zài wán.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu jìn lái le ma?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 都进来了，包也拿进来了。
dialogues.pinyin: Dōu jìn lái le, bāo yě ná jìn lái le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ bǎ mén guān shang?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 等一下，先看看门外还有没有东西。
dialogues.pinyin: Děng yí xià, xiān kàn kàn mén wài hái yǒu méi yǒu dōng xi.
dialogues.tr: Bir dakika, önce dışarıda eşya kaldı mı bakalım.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 我看过了，外面没有我们的东西。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guò le, wài miàn méi yǒu wǒ men de dōng xi.
dialogues.tr: Baktım, dışarıda bize ait eşya kalmadı.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, xiàn zài kě yǐ guān mén le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ qīng qīng guān, bú huì hěn xiǎng.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Xiǎo xīn shǒu, bié fàng zài mén biān.
dialogues.tr: Eline dikkat et, kapının kenarına koyma.
dialogues.actionTr: Kardeşinin elini kapı kenarından uzak tutmasını söyler.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 关好了，钥匙也在妈妈那里。
dialogues.pinyin: Guān hǎo le, yào shi yě zài mā ma nà lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhōng yú néng xiē yí huìr le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 可是我已经想看里面了！
dialogues.pinyin: Kě shì wǒ yǐ jīng xiǎng kàn lǐ miàn le!
dialogues.tr: Ama ben şimdiden içeriye bakmak istiyorum!

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 我也想看，不过先把东西放好。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng kàn, bù guò xiān bǎ dōng xi fàng hǎo.
dialogues.tr: Ben de bakmak istiyorum, ama önce eşyaları yerleştirelim.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ men yì qǐ màn màn lái.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān kàn kàn xiāng zi yào fàng nǎ lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 我搬不了大的，能拿小的吗？
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ bān bù liǎo dà de, néng ná xiǎo de ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 当然，我们先从小的开始。
dialogues.pinyin: Dāng rán, wǒ men xiān cóng xiǎo de kāi shǐ.
dialogues.actionTr: Kardeşine yapabileceği küçük bir iş önerir.
